$comment: Progression (round 05, stream E; brief §3: three upgrade branches per class, small but noticeable, bought with credits). perLevel = multiplier added per bought level on base max hp (armor), top speed (engine) or damage dealt (gun). cost[i] = credits for level i+1. Applies to the human player's tank only, in every mode. quickMatch: credits per kill and for a won match (your team has more kills). All numbers are a first proposal — owner decides (rule 4).
